hook_line: AIR INDIA RESTORES NON-STOP FLIGHTS TO NEW YORK

hook_stat.sub: Journey time cut, from around 22 hours to approximately 17 hours

stats.label: Routes restored: Delhi and Mumbai to JFK and Newark
Approximate journey time, down from around 22 hours with the Rome stop

diaspora_bullets: Newark services do not run daily - check your flight date
Pakistan airspace remains closed, so timings can still change
news_summary: Air India has restored non-stop flights on all four India-New York routes - Delhi and Mumbai to JFK and Newark - ending the Rome refuelling stop, the airline said on November 15.
payoff: Journey times fall by up to five hours with the Rome stop discontinued.
